@@ -0,0 +1,332 @@
+package trafficpolicy
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"slices"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	envoyroutev3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/config/route/v3"
+	envoy_type_matcher_v3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/type/matcher/v3"
+	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
+	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/durationpb"
+
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/api/v1alpha1/kgateway"
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/pkg/utils/regexutils"
+)
+
+type consistentHashIR struct {
+	hashPolicies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	disable      bool
+}
+
+var _ PolicySubIR = &consistentHashIR{}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Equals(other PolicySubIR) bool {
+	otherConsistentHash, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c == nil && otherConsistentHash == nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	if c == nil || otherConsistentHash == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c.disable != otherConsistentHash.disable {
+		return false
+	}
+	return slices.EqualFunc(c.hashPolicies, otherConsistentHash.hashPolicies, func(a, b *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) bool {
+		return proto.Equal(a, b)
+	})
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	for _, hp := range c.hashPolicies {
+		if hp == nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		if header := hp.GetHeader(); header != nil {
+			if rr := header.GetRegexRewrite(); rr != nil && rr.GetPattern() != nil {
+				if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(rr.GetPattern().GetRegex()); err != nil {
+					return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern: %w", err)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if err := hp.ValidateAll(); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) clone() *consistentHashIR {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	out := &consistentHashIR{
+		disable: c.disable,
+	}
+	if len(c.hashPolicies) > 0 {
+		out.hashPolicies = make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, len(c.hashPolicies))
+		for i, hp := range c.hashPolicies {
+			out.hashPolicies[i] = proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy)
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
+
+func parseCookieTTL(ttl string) (time.Duration, error) {
+	if d, err := time.ParseDuration(ttl); err == nil {
+		if d < 0 {
+			return 0, fmt.Errorf("cookie ttl %q cannot be negative", ttl)
+		}
+		return d, nil
+	}
+	if secs, err := strconv.ParseInt(ttl, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		if secs < 0 {
+			return 0, fmt.Errorf("cookie ttl %q cannot be negative", ttl)
+		}
+		return time.Duration(secs) * time.Second, nil
+	}
+	return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: must be a valid Go duration or integer seconds", ttl)
+}
+
+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) error {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash
+	if ch.Disable {
+		if len(ch.Headers) > 0 || len(ch.Cookies) > 0 || len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 || len(ch.FilterState) > 0 || ch.SourceIp != nil {
+			return errors.New("consistentHash: when disable is true, no other fields may be set")
+		}
+		out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+			disable: true,
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	var hashPolicies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+	// 1. Headers (case-insensitive deduplication preserving first occurrence casing)
+	if len(ch.Headers) > 0 {
+		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.Headers))
+		for _, h := range ch.Headers {
+			key := strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)
+			if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seen[key] = struct{}{}
+
+			headerPolicy := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+				HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+			}
+			if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+				if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(h.RegexRewrite.Pattern); err != nil {
+					return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern in consistentHash header %q: %w", h.HeaderName, err)
+				}
+				headerPolicy.RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+					Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+						Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+					},
+					Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+				}
+			}
+			hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+					Header: headerPolicy,
+				},
+				Terminal: h.Terminal,
+			})
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 2. Cookies (deduplicated by name preserving first occurrence)
+	if len(ch.Cookies) > 0 {
+		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.Cookies))
+		for _, c := range ch.Cookies {
+			if _, exists := seen[c.Name]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seen[c.Name] = struct{}{}
+
+			cookiePolicy := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+				Name: c.Name,
+				Path: c.Path,
+			}
+			if c.TTL != "" {
+				d, err := parseCookieTTL(c.TTL)
+				if err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				cookiePolicy.Ttl = durationpb.New(d)
+			}
+			if len(c.Attributes) > 0 {
+				attrs := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute, 0, len(c.Attributes))
+				for _, attr := range c.Attributes {
+					attrs = append(attrs, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+						Name:  attr.Name,
+						Value: attr.Value,
+					})
+				}
+				cookiePolicy.Attributes = attrs
+			}
+			hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+					Cookie: cookiePolicy,
+				},
+				Terminal: c.Terminal,
+			})
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 3. QueryParameters (deduplicated by name preserving first occurrence)
+	if len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 {
+		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.QueryParameters))
+		for _, qp := range ch.QueryParameters {
+			if _, exists := seen[qp.Name]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seen[qp.Name] = struct{}{}
+
+			hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+					QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+						Name: qp.Name,
+					},
+				},
+				Terminal: qp.Terminal,
+			})
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 4. FilterState (deduplicated by key preserving first occurrence)
+	if len(ch.FilterState) > 0 {
+		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.FilterState))
+		for _, fs := range ch.FilterState {
+			if _, exists := seen[fs.Key]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seen[fs.Key] = struct{}{}
+
+			hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+					FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+						Key: fs.Key,
+					},
+				},
+				Terminal: fs.Terminal,
+			})
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 5. SourceIp
+	if ch.SourceIp != nil {
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: ch.SourceIp.Terminal,
+		})
+	}
+
+	// Default to a single sourceIp hash policy with terminal=false if no sub-fields are specified
+	if len(hashPolicies) == 0 {
+		hashPolicies = []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+					ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+						SourceIp: true,
+					},
+				},
+				Terminal: false,
+			},
+		}
+	}
+
+	out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+		hashPolicies: hashPolicies,
+	}
+	return nil

+func mergeConsistentHashIR(high, low *consistentHashIR) *consistentHashIR {
+	var (
+		headers      []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+		cookies      []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+		queryParams  []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+		filterStates []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+		sourceIps    []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	)
+
+	seenHeaders := make(map[string]struct{})
+	seenCookies := make(map[string]struct{})
+	seenQueryParams := make(map[string]struct{})
+	seenFilterStates := make(map[string]struct{})
+
+	for _, hp := range slices.Concat(high.hashPolicies, low.hashPolicies) {
+		switch spec := hp.GetPolicySpecifier().(type) {
+		case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_:
+			key := strings.ToLower(spec.Header.GetHeaderName())
+			if _, exists := seenHeaders[key]; !exists {
+				seenHeaders[key] = struct{}{}
+				headers = append(headers, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+			}
+		case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_:
+			key := spec.Cookie.GetName()
+			if _, exists := seenCookies[key]; !exists {
+				seenCookies[key] = struct{}{}
+				cookies = append(cookies, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+			}
+		case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_:
+			key := spec.QueryParameter.GetName()
+			if _, exists := seenQueryParams[key]; !exists {
+				seenQueryParams[key] = struct{}{}
+				queryParams = append(queryParams, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+			}
+		case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_:
+			key := spec.FilterState.GetKey()
+			if _, exists := seenFilterStates[key]; !exists {
+				seenFilterStates[key] = struct{}{}
+				filterStates = append(filterStates, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	// The sourceIp scalar retains the higher-priority policy's value even when unset.
+	for _, hp := range high.hashPolicies {
+		if hp.GetConnectionProperties() != nil {
+			sourceIps = append(sourceIps, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+		}
+	}
+
+	// Re-sort into canonical type order: headers, cookies, queryParameters, filterState, sourceIp.
+	merged := slices.Concat(headers, cookies, queryParams, filterStates, sourceIps)
+	return &consistentHashIR{
+		hashPolicies: merged,
+	}
+}
+
+func applyConsistentHash(consistentHash *consistentHashIR, out *envoyroutev3.Route) {
+	if consistentHash == nil || out == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	action := out.GetRoute()
+	if action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	if consistentHash.disable {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+	action.HashPolicy = consistentHash.hashPolicies
+}
